UserPublicProfile.title: User Public Profile
UserPublicProfile.description: Publicly readable non-PII listener profile stored at /users/{userId}.

UserPrivateInfo.title: User Private Info
UserPrivateInfo.description: Strictly owner-only PII document containing user email.

UserLibraryState.title: User Library State
UserLibraryState.description: Synced liked track IDs and pinned match IDs owned by the authenticated listener.

likedIds.description: Bounded list of up to 200 liked track IDs.

pinnedMatchIds.description: Bounded list of up to 50 pinned match IDs.

UserPlaylistDoc.title: User Playlist Document
UserPlaylistDoc.description: Custom playlist created and owned by an authenticated listener.

trackIds.description: Bounded list of up to 200 track IDs.

CommunityStageScore.title: Community 3D Stage Rhythm Score
CommunityStageScore.description: Immutable verified score entry submitted by an authenticated listener for the 3D Stage Rhythm Game.

/users/{userId}.description: Non-PII public profile document for a Soundmark user.

/users/{userId}/private/info.description: Isolated PII document storing user email, readable and writable only by the owner.

/users/{userId}/library/state.description: Owner-only synced library state (liked tracks and pinned matches).

/stageScores/{scoreId}.description: Immutable 3D Rhythm Stage Game leaderboard scores.
